<!--
The show rule that gives a link its colour was written into the body, and in
journal mode the front matter is split up before the body is assembled: a
raw block at the end of it was taken for part of the author note and the rule
ended up inside the note, where it coloured the note's own links and nothing
else. The rules are held back now and put in after the masthead is built.

The page break that goes before a list is not written in journal mode, which
runs continuously. It used to be dropped by the same split, which throws away
every #pagebreak it is given.

The rule goes at the head of the document rather than where the body begins,
so that the masthead takes it too: the corresponding author's email is a
link, and so is anything written into the abstract. Both were left the blue
the template gives a link.
-->
